inspection_history.inspect: Rendered 3x3 decisive-key montage from the actual ASCII-rig MP4.
inspection_history.highest_value_visible_defect: K3/K4 airborne silhouettes were too bilateral and K4 read as a generic T-pose tuck; travel intent and carried momentum weakened at the apex.
inspection_history.bounded_correction: Re-authored only K3/K4 arm and leg asymmetry while preserving root coordinates, NO_SUPPORT truth, timing classes, and ballistic state sequence.

inspection_history.inspect: Rerendered the actual MP4 after the K3/K4 asymmetry correction and inspected the complete decisive-key sequence as extracted video frames.
inspection_history.highest_value_visible_defect: No material defect remained: support marks are legible, root arc rises/falls continuously, K5 reach remains NO_SUPPORT, K6 catch visibly acquires left support without stopping root travel, K7 pays landing cost through compression, and K8 recovers before the next stride.
inspection_history.bounded_correction: None; further edits would add detail rather than repair locomotion truth.

taste_function_contempt.TASTE: PASS — the specimen has a specific support-handoff idea rather than a generic jump loop; the asymmetric airborne keys carry direction and intent.
taste_function_contempt.FUNCTION: PASS — takeoff contact, unsupported travel, landing probe, catch, absorption, and recovery are causally readable; root movement does not teleport at either ownership boundary.
taste_function_contempt.CONTEMPT: PASS — no decorative tween sludge, no source-derived costume/silhouette, no fake contact, and no free recovery; the landing visibly costs posture and time.

visible_reasons: K1 lowers and advances the pelvis over the same planted right support, making anticipation/load visible.
K2 keeps right support until the final release key; K3 begins airborne only after that contact is gone.
K5 places the reaching left foot near ground while still explicitly NO_SUPPORT, separating reach from ownership.
K6 acquires left support while the root continues forward; K7 compresses on that same support before K8 re-stacks.
The root path and spacing carry momentum through the full chain, so the motion reads as travel rather than pose swapping.
